text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 429s and token-billing anomalies after quota-v3 rollout in eu-central-1.

rachel: Noticing a spike starting ~09:12 UTC. 429s ~15% on /v1/chat and some customers seeing retries.

devin: Correlating with release: quota-v3 feature-flag enabled for 20% rollout at 09:10.

liam: Logs show exemption header parsing changed: header 'X-Quota-Exempt' now parsed as string->list; when blank it becomes [''] which downstream treats as valid exemption and zeroes tokens incorrectly for some paths. That then triggers quota short-circuit and denies requests once token budget is used.

nina: Product-support reports two high-touch customers (GreenBank, FlowHealth) saw 10-30% failures. They've opened Sev1 tickets.

oncall-sre: I'm taking this pager. First action: check canary kill-switch and release controller.

rachel: ops-bot run: 
```
opsctl ff get quota-v3 --scope=canary-eu
```

ops-bot: quota-v3: canary-eu=true, global=false.

devin: If we flip canary off it should stop new hosts from processing exemptions under new logic. But some hosts already have it.

ops-bot: Flipping feature flag: 
```
opsctl ff set quota-v3 false --scope=canary-eu
```

ops-bot: done. Propagating to canary hosts.

incident-bot: 429 rate dropped to ~7% within 90s.

liam: Good. We still need to prevent affected hosts that already received the binary from continuing to serve bad logic. Suggest pausing rollout and back-rev those hosts.

oncall-sre: Pausing rollout: 
```
releasectl pause --release=quota-v3-eu
```

releasectl: release paused, no further hosts will be updated.

prod-support: GreenBank confirmed recovery to ~0.5% errors after flag flip; FlowHealth still seeing intermittent failures on longer requests.

liam: Another problem: token billing entries sometimes show tokens=0 on initial ledger add and then tokens=64 added later for same request_id. Could result in billing double-count if reconciliation runs. Example log: 
```
[quota] req=zz77 added tokens=0
[ledger] req=zz77 added tokens=64
```
We need to audit ledgers.

rachel: Can we temporarily disable quota enforcement entirely for affected customers while we investigate? That would avoid 429s but risks overuse.

oncall-sre: That is an option for a small set of enterprise tenants. We'll coordinate with prod-support and billing. @billing are we okay with temporary waivers for GreenBank and FlowHealth?

billing: We can flag them and waive overages for a short interval if needed, but we need formal approval. Suggest prod-support outreach first.

prod-support: Reaching out to contacts now and requesting permission to enable lenient quotas for those tenants.

incident-bot: Rollback candidate identified: previous prod image tag quota-v2-stable (sha: d4f3a21). Recommendation: roll back canary hosts first, then assess.

rachel: Initiating rollback to d4f3a21 on impacted hosts. Command: 
```
releasectl rollback --release=quota-v3-eu --to=d4f3a21 --scope=canary
```

releasectl: rollback job started. Host list: i-eu1, i-eu2, i-eu3, i-eu4.

ops-bot: host i-eu1 -> success, i-eu2 -> success, i-eu3 -> success, i-eu4 -> success. Traffic shifted back.

incident-bot: Post-rollback 429s returned to baseline ~0.2% (09:18 UTC).

liam: Good. We'll open an engineering bug for the parsing logic + ledger race: ENG-7890 "quota-v3: X-Quota-Exempt parsing and ledger double-add". I'll add reproducer and stack traces.

devin: Also adding a new integration test: header-absent and header-empty cases should map to null exemptions, not [''].

nina: Customer outreach in progress; draft message ready for review. Two customers impacted for ~6 minutes at scale — likely retry/backoff triggered.

billing: We'll run a quick ledger reconciliation and flag any suspicious duplicate billing for manual review. If duplicates found we'll credit customers.

rachel: Monitoring: add temporary alert for 'quota.exempt.parse.failures > 0' and a dashboard panel showing exemption value histogram (null vs empty-string vs list).

incident-bot: Severity set to P2. No ongoing outage after rollback. Monitoring window 24h.

oncall-sre: Handoff notes for next oncall at 10:00 UTC: rollback complete, rollout paused, ff quota-v3 set to false for canary-eu, bug ENG-7890 created and assigned to runtime team (liam). Billing reconciliation in progress, prod-support handling outreach.

rachel: Postmortem owners: runtime (liam), release (rachel), customer-success (nina). Initial draft due 48h.

liam: Quick add  - please also check our canary rollout tooling for verification step that asserts exemption histogram is unchanged within tolerance before promoting. I'll add a gating check.

prod-support: GreenBank confirms normal operation and appreciates prompt reversal. FlowHealth acknowledged workaround and asked for a follow-up call.

rachel: Thanks all. I'll file a retrospective and schedule a brief blameless review. :thumbsup:
